title: The Convoy Ambiguity: Feed-Forward 3D and 4D Reconstruction Models Inherit the Epipolar Degeneracy for Motion Parallel to Camera Translation
contribution_type: Scientific discovery (primary); Evaluation (motion-decomposed protocol for dynamic-scene reconstruction); an elementary, exact geometric law fixes the falsifiable prediction (not a general theory paper).
research_question: Do frozen feed-forward 3D/4D reconstruction models (DUSt3R, VGGT, MonST3R, ...) reconstruct an object moving parallel to the camera's translation at the exact depth a static object at that location would have (Z*(s)=Z/(1-s)), and do training-free dynamic-mask methods built on epipolar-inconsistency fail to flag exactly this motion?
central_hypothesis: For static-trained feed-forward models, the predicted depth of an object moving with parallel displacement fraction s and perpendicular pixel offset eps~=0 satisfies Zhat/Z = 1/(1-s) to within the model's static-scene error, with no increase in any dynamic-mask signal; as eps grows, the prediction departs from the epipolar solution toward the model's monocular estimate; dynamic-trained models differ from static-trained ones only in the eps>0 regime and, at eps~=0, deviate from 1/(1-s) only for object classes with strong size priors.
falsification_conditions: The hypothesis is FALSIFIED if: (a) Zhat/Z is insensitive to s (priors dominate everywhere -> beta_s CI excludes [0.5,1.5] or R^2<0.5 at eps~=0); (b) dynamic-mask methods flag parallel motion (|eps|<1px) as reliably as perpendicular motion (eps>=3px) -> recall-difference CI includes 0; or (c) dynamic-trained models beat Z*(s) at eps~=0 for ALL object classes, i.e. no class-dependent prior takeover is observed.

propositions_exact_and_verified.Proposition 1 (parallel-motion degenerac: delta = s*b (pure parallel motion) makes the moving point's camera-2 coordinates identical, up to a positive scalar, to the static point X* = X/(1-s)'s camera-2 coordinates -> both pixels are indistinguishable from a static point at depth Z*(s) = Z/(1-s). Verified numerically in Section 2 to floating-point precision, for arbitrary camera rotation R.
propositions_exact_and_verified.Proposition 2 (multi-view convoy persist: If the camera's TRANSLATION per frame is constant (b each frame -> a straight path) and the object's own world-frame velocity is s*b (constant, parallel to that translation), the degeneracy persists for any number of frames and for ANY per-frame camera ROTATION R_k. It requires a CHANGE in the camera's translation direction (a curved path / true turning) to break -- rotation of the camera's heading alone, with a straight translation path, does NOT break it. This distinction is verified numerically in Section 2.
propositions_exact_and_verified.Proposition 3 (perpendicular motion is d: If the perpendicular component delta_perp != 0, no static point reproduces both observations; the second observation lies eps pixels off the true epipolar line -- the only first-order geometric evidence of motion available to a two-view method.

assumptions.A1 (correspondence-based depth): The model's two-view depth for textured object pixels is driven by cross-view correspondence, not monocular cues alone. DIRECTLY TESTABLE per model via the static-scene sensitivity test (mask the corresponding patch in view 2, observe the depth change). If it fails for a model, w~=1 is EXPECTED for that model and is reported as such, not treated as a hypothesis failure.
assumptions.A2 (small-displacement first-order geome: eps computed to first order (eps ~= f*||delta_perp||/Z) is adequate. DIRECTLY TESTABLE by comparing the first-order formula against the exact epipolar-line perpendicular distance on synthetic data with known geometry. Where it is violated, the EXACT offset is used instead for regime classification -- see Section 2.3 for the measured divergence.
assumptions.A3 (ground-truth adequacy): Synthetic data supplies exact depth/velocity by construction; any real data (Sintel, TUM) supplies GT depth/flow/poses with bounded, documented sensor noise. STRUCTURAL for the synthetic testbed (true by construction); EMPIRICALLY PROXY-TESTABLE for any real dataset that loads, via GT self-consistency checks.

falsifiable_numerical_predictions.Prediction 1 (degeneracy): beta_s in [0.8,1.2] (95% cluster-bootstrap CI) for static-trained models in the parallel regime (|eps|<1px), R^2>=0.5.
falsifiable_numerical_predictions.Prediction 2 (masks): Dynamic-mask recall for |eps|<1px is lower than for eps>=3px by >=0.3 absolute, at matched |s| and object size.
falsifiable_numerical_predictions.Prediction 3 (prior takeover): Prior weight w increases with eps (Spearman rho>0.5) and, at eps~=0, is larger for size-prior-bearing classes than for texture-only synthetic objects.
falsifiable_numerical_predictions.Prediction 4 (convoy persistence): beta_s stays in [0.8,1.2] over 2-8 frames on straight (constant-translation) segments and drops toward 0 on segments with a genuinely curved translation path.

method_under_test: Feed-forward 3D/4D reconstruction models, probed by the measurement protocol in Section 4 (not a newly proposed architecture).
datasets_actually_used_this_notebook: CONVOY-3D (ray-cast synthetic street scenes; plays the role of Kubric MOVi-F, Section 3.1), including the v6 ground-contact ablation (E5)
LEGACY-FLAT (negative control for the validity gate, Section 3.4)
TUM RGB-D fr3 static sequences (real backgrounds for the CONVOY-REAL composites, Section 3.5, and for the v6.1 contact ablation on real images, E5-REAL, Section 3.5.1)
TUM RGB-D fr3 walking_xyz / walking_halfsphere (prevalence of motion regimes only, Section 3.7)
Virtual KITTI 2, clone variation, Camera_0 (photo-realistic driving with exact depth and poses, Section 3.8)
Argoverse 2 sensor dataset, validation logs, front-centre camera (real driving with LiDAR; exploratory, Sections 3.11-3.11c)
KITTI tracking (real driving with LiDAR; only when attached; exploratory, Section 3.10)
CONVOY-3D designed experiments of v6.5: baseline sweep (BSW) and contact dose-response (WDR), Section 3.2b
Bonn RGB-D Dynamic, four sequences with balloons and boxes moved by people (real objects with measured depth; exploratory, Section 3.12)
baselines_per_idea: Classical two-view triangulation with GT poses (positive control -- MUST follow 1/(1-s) exactly)
Monocular model / oracle (negative control -- MUST be s-invariant)
sota_position: Scientific discovery + evaluation advance. The paper predicts a FAILURE of existing dynamic-mask methods rather than beating a leaderboard. No SOTA is claimed anywhere in this notebook.
claim_scope: Findings are scoped to: (i) the specific models whose checkpoints actually loaded in THIS execution (see MODEL_STATUS in Section 4); (ii) the datasets that actually became available (see DATASET_STATUS in Section 3); (iii) the parameter ranges swept (depth 5-60 m, |s| up to 1.4, frame gaps and baselines documented in Section 0.2). No claim in this notebook generalizes beyond what is listed here.
